question: How many products does the shop have?
Which products contain the material lead? Give the product names.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:HAS_PART]->(:Component)-[:CONTAINS]->(m:Material {name: 'Lead'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS name

question: Which customers bought a product that contains cadmium?
cypher: MATCH (cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(:Bill)-[:INCLUDES]->(:Product)-[:HAS_PART]->(:Component)-[:CONTAINS]->(m:Material {name: 'Cadmium'}) RETURN DISTINCT cu.name AS name

question: What is the price of the Voltaris Pulse 6?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {name: 'Voltaris Pulse 6'}) RETURN p.unit_price AS price

question: Which manufacturer makes the component 'Li-ion pouch cell 4500 mAh'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Component {name: 'Li-ion pouch cell 4500 mAh'})-[:MADE_BY]->(m:Manufacturer) RETURN m.name AS name

question: How many refurbished products are there?
Which hazardous materials does the Nordlicht DECT Phone contain?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {name: 'Nordlicht DECT Phone'})-[:HAS_PART]->(:Component)-[:CONTAINS]->(m:Hazardous) RETURN DISTINCT m.name AS name

question: Which product category has the highest sales revenue?
cypher: MATCH (:Bill)-[i:INCLUDES]->(p:Product) WITH p.category AS category, sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN category
universe: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN DISTINCT p.category AS name

question: How many different components is the Voltaris Pulse 6 built from?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {name: 'Voltaris Pulse 6'})-[:HAS_PART]->(c:Component) RETURN count(c) AS n
